SandboxPillars.levaGottBody: Living Well: We humans share the same basic physical needs — clean air, clean water, food, clothing, housing, security, wellbeing, and more. GoodTribes wants to give everyone the opportunity to meet these needs by being able to make a living through their commitment to long-term sustainable environmental and social development.
SandboxPillars.maGottBody: Feeling Good: We humans share the same basic psychological needs — belonging, appreciation, love, self-determination, freedom, fairness, growth, and engagement. GoodTribes wants to give everyone the freedom and opportunity to realize their dreams and their full potential.
SandboxPillars.goraGottBody: Doing Good: We humans share the same underlying desire for happiness, meaning, and being part of something bigger than ourselves. GoodTribes is grounded in research showing that people experience their greatest and most lasting happiness, satisfaction, and meaning when we make the world better together with others.
SandboxPillars.dreamGoodBody: Dream Big: We humans share the same dreams about a better life.

ideaBand.heading: Got an idea or dream that could make the world better?
ideaBand.placeholder: E.g. a tool library in every neighborhood

stepsCarousel.heading: From idea to change
stepsCarousel.step0Title: It all starts with a dream of a better world
stepsCarousel.step0Body: Big or small — the dream is what sets everything in motion. Share it, and GoodTribes helps you take the first step toward making it real.
stepsCarousel.step1Title: Find the projects that fit you and join the tribe
stepsCarousel.step1Body: Search for what you care about — bees, oceans, safer neighborhoods, computers for schools. Join the crew around a project, say what you can contribute, and pick a task that fits your time and skills.
stepsCarousel.step2Title: Turn your dream into a real project
stepsCarousel.step2Body: Post it — it becomes a project with its own page, open budget, and tasks from day one. Now it's more than just a thought.
stepsCarousel.step3Title: Change the world through small and large efforts
stepsCarousel.step3Body: An hour, a donated computer, a skill traded. Change from below always starts with a small group of people working towards a shared dream.
stepsCarousel.step4Body: Every realized dream is a step closer to a world where everyone gets to Live Well, Feel Good, and Do Good — and no one has to do it alone.

HomePage.heroDefaultBody: GoodTribes gives everyone the opportunity to realize their own and others' dreams and ideas. One idea, one tribe, and a clear path forward, from day one.

visionMissionGoal.visionBody: GoodTribes' vision is long-term sustainable environmental and social development, where everyone is given the opportunity to realize their dreams/ideas and their full potential, while getting to Live Well, Feel Good, and Do Good for themselves and others.
visionMissionGoal.missionBody: To achieve our vision, we want to give everyone free access to the tools, processes, networks, and resources needed to realize dreams/ideas that directly or indirectly make the world better.
visionMissionGoal.goalBody: Create an open "dream factory", where anyone can easily and quickly start, develop, and run nonprofit and commercial ideas and dreams that directly or indirectly contribute to long-term sustainable environmental and social development.
visionMissionGoal.foundationNote: GoodTribes.org is owned and governed by the nonprofit GoodTribes foundation, whose purpose is to work towards long-term sustainable environmental and social development.

phaseMap.heading: Where projects are on their journey

usageNow.heading: A tool for every goal
usageNow.leanCanvasGoal: Sharpen the business model before you build
usageNow.leanCanvasBody: Problem, solution, audience and revenue — the whole idea on one page, ready to pitch or challenge.
usageNow.crowdfundingBody: Launch a campaign and let your tribe chip in, with full visibility into every krona that comes in.
usageNow.pollsBody: Weight votes by everyone's share of Tribe Tokens — not by who shouts loudest.
usageNow.kanbanGoal: Break the idea into concrete steps
usageNow.kanbanBody: Split the work into tasks, keep track of who's doing what, and watch it all move forward.
usageNow.tokensGoal: Reward the work that actually matters
usageNow.tokensBody: Hand out Tribe Tokens and GT for work that genuinely moves the project forward.
usageNow.ideaSessionsBody: Bounce ideas around in the Idea Workshop, with an AI that helps sort the thinking into a mindmap.

impactSnapshot.heading: What the tribe has achieved together

tools.heading: Professional tools that follow you all the way
tools.intro: No loose notes. In the Dream Factory, every idea gets the same tools as a real project — try them freely before you decide.
tools.reassurance: Free, no account required to look around — and nothing binding until you're ready.
tools.leanCanvasBody: Problem, solution, audience, and revenue — the whole business model on one page.
tools.valuePropositionBody: Match what you offer against what the customer actually needs — Osterwalder's canvas.
tools.whiteboardBody: Free visual space for sketching and structuring ideas together.
tools.kanbanBody: Break the idea down into concrete tasks and keep track of who's doing what.
tools.fundingBody: Raise money with full transparency — every krona shows up in the budget.
tools.pollsBody: Weigh big decisions together, weighted by your share of Tribe Tokens.
tools.tokensBody: Hand out Tribe Tokens and GT for contributions that make a difference.
tools.sprintsBody: Asynchronous design sprints — map, sketch, decide, build, test.
tools.ideaSessionsBody: Brainstorm with others — and with an AI that helps structure the thinking.
tools.blogBody: Share updates and lessons learned with the whole tribe.
tools.wikiBody: Gather knowledge and documentation in one place.
tools.kanalerBody: Talk directly with your tribe, in real time.
tools.calendarBody: Keep track of deadlines and meetings, shared with the whole tribe.
tools.filesBody: Share documents and images in one place everyone in the tribe can find.
tools.ganttBody: Plan timelines and dependencies between tasks.
tools.todosBody: Simple to-do lists for the quick stuff.
